verdict.driver: COLUMN-count driven with per-session accumulation (page-pin leak); NOT row-driven, NOT total-cell driven
verdict.threshold: first scoring upload: <=73 scoring cols PASS, 74 cols HANG (livelock, no response), >=76 cols instant 500. Independent of which columns (first-N vs last-N families agree) and independent of rows (50 rows still fails at 130 cols).
verdict.arithmetic: cells = rows x cols: PASS at 999x73 = 72,927 cells but FAIL at 50x130 = 6,500 cells -> cell/byte models dead (binary fixture also passed at 1000x72 = 72,000 cells with LARGER file bytes 653KB vs 620KB). Column-page pin model: session cumulative column-pages = train_cols + sum(scoring_cols per upload). PASS max = 74 train + 73 scoring = 147; HANG = 75 + 74 = 149; hard 500 from 77 + 76 = 153 up. Leak proof: 74 + 73 = 147 passes, then same-session second 73-col upload (147 + 73 = 220) instantly 500s. So frames are pinned per profiled column per upload, never unpinned, budget ~147-148 frames.
verdict.wedge: after any predict 500 or hang the session sticks and the whole web API of that container becomes unusable (matches WEB-13); fresh container required per probe after failure
verdict.bonus_bug: TRAIN-side: first-N column subsets at 72 and 76 features deterministically fail training with 'unsupported artifact backend: bma' (blend/BMA wins selection, artifact persistence lacks bma backend). Seed fixed at 20260616 and not overridable via API. Distinct from WEB-13; suggest filing separately (candidate WEB-14).
